request.style: English, male tenor solo with soft backing choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, gentle strings, hopeful and urgent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The kingdom is like treasure in the field
A man found it and hid it again
In his joy he went and sold his all
To buy the field where the treasure lay

[Chorus]
He sold everything he had
For the pearl of great value
The merchant found one precious stone
And gave his life for it

[Verse]
A net let down into the deep sea
Caught fish of every kind and sort
They hauled it up upon the shore
And sat to sort the good from bad

[Chorus]
He sold everything he had
For the pearl of great value
The merchant found one precious stone
And gave his life for it

[Bridge]
At the end of the age they come
To separate the wicked from the just
The righteous shine like the sun
In the kingdom of the Father

[Chorus]
He sold everything he had
For the pearl of great value
The merchant found one precious stone
And gave his life for it

[Outro]
Whoever has ears let him hear
The joy of finding the truth
